venturesTitle: Working with other kinds of signals
venturesLead: Between my PhD and postdoctoral work, I worked on smell and small body movements in health hardware.
dozeeDescription: At Dozee, I worked on contactless vital-sign monitoring using small body vibrations, including sensors and validation rigs. I also worked with clinicians on deployments in more than 200 hospitals.
essensariDescription: In 2020–21, I co-founded Essensari and developed a loss-of-smell screening device and Android app. The prototype delivered odours; the app asked people to identify them. I also contributed to the GCCR consortium studies on smell loss during the pandemic.

documentTitle: Pavan — I make insects play video games
metaDescription: I’m Pavan. I study how insects navigate the real world with tiny brains, build research tools, make science videos in Kannada, and work on exhibits and civic projects.
ogTitle: Pavan — Insects, tools and other work
ogDescription: Research, tools, exhibits, civic projects and science in Kannada.
classroomText: Students move through a shared field as foxes. I can change who sees whom and what cues they receive, then we compare how the group aligns, splits or finds a hidden patch.
